title: mapouria balansae
intro: Mapouria balansae, commonly known as Mapouria, is a plant species that belongs to the family Annonaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, respiratory issues, and digestive problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Mapouria include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and protect cells from damage. The bioactive constituents of Mapouria include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
